The '''Great force pike''' was a longer version of the standard [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]]. It was commissioned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] throne for use by ceremonial guards. It required 4 [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] to operate.
